title: KiwiCatAPI
description: This is a API i use for some of my Mods
body:
This is a simple API i use for some of my Mods.

It currently has:
- a UwUfier Class
- a simple way to change skins Client-Side

More Features will Follow...

A Wiki is done and available [here](https://github.com/kiwicat-minecraft/KiwiCatAPI/blob/main/wiki/main.md)!
